descripcion: Umamusume bot for Uma Musume: Pretty Derby (Global): hands-off career training on Android and MuMu Player. Run queues, trainee rotation, built-in presets for URA Finale, Unity Cup, Trackblazer and Grand Concert. Free and open source, based on steve1316's uma-android-automation.
